musical_instruments_avg_price: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'musical instruments'
musical_instruments_missing_timestamp: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'musical instruments' AND epoch_seconds IS NULL AND year IS NULL AND month IS NULL
musical_instruments_missing_timestamp_re: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'musical instruments' AND (year IS NULL OR month IS NULL)
musical_instruments_price_above_avg: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.category = p.category AND r.ref_id = p.ref_id WHERE p.category = 'musical instruments' AND p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'musical instruments') AND (r.year IS NULL OR r.month IS NULL)
